Corrected Korais text classification (anti-pamphlet rather than epistolary), distinguished his uncertainty from later annotation. Distinguished Cassomoulis' reported actions, perceived danger and emotion from verified intention or moral justification. Differentiated remembered dialogue from verbatim documentation in Kolokotronis. Kalvos lyric praise distinguished from historical evidence.
